reasoning.step1:
Classification:
- Document contains clear invoice indicators: headings "Rechnung", invoice number 125349, invoice date, line items, totals, VAT, invoice-like headers. No exclusion terms ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", "Servicebericht") dominate. Classified as an invoice.

Extraction sources and decisions:
- Invoice.Date: Located at top and in header area: "Datum 05.10.23" and "Rechnungsdatum 05.10.23". Chosen value: 05.10.23.
- Sender.VatId: Found as "MWST Nr. ATU16406805" / "USt-IdNr. ATU16406805" at top. Chosen value: ATU16406805.
- GrandTotal.Amount: "Total EUR inkl. MwSt. 3’949.09" on page 3. Converted formatting to numeric 3949.09 (preserve decimals).
- Net.Amount: "Total EUR ohne MwSt. 3’290.91" on page 3. Numeric 3290.91.
- Vat.Amount: Shown as 658.18 next to net/ VAT table on page 3. Numeric 658.18.
- Vat.Rate: Steuersatz 20.00 shown; per rules remove percentage symbol and keep numeric: 20.00 → choose 20 (per schema expects number; keep decimals as in source—source shows 20.00 but instructions say extract rates without %; will represent as numeric 20 or 20.00 — note to preserve decimals as in input: 20.00).

Validation and no-inference policy:
- All extracted values are directly present in the text; no values were inferred.
- If ambiguity existed, fields would be left empty, but here explicit totals and VAT lines are present.

Multiple occurrences check:
- VAT rate and totals appear once for the invoice-level summary; no multiple exchange rates or conflicting groups found.

Conclusion:
- Document accepted as invoice; extracted fields: Invoice.Date = "05.10.23", Sender.VatId = "ATU16406805", GrandTotal.Amount = 3949.09, Net.Amount = 3290.91, Vat.Amount = 658.18, Vat.Rate = 20 (20.00 shown in source).

- Net.Amount = 3290.91
  Evidence: Page 3 shows "Total EUR ohne MwSt. 3’290.91". Interpreted as 3290.91. Consistency: addition with VAT equals GrandTotal. Confidence: Very high.

- Vat.Amount = 658.18
  Evidence: Page 3 displays 658.18 adjacent to VAT row; 3290.91 + 658.18 = 3949.09. Confidence: Very high.

- Vat.Rate = 20 (from "Steuersatz 20.00")
